title: Website clips — shorter, zoomed in, one rhythm

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 1, "Tools and conversations work across any model."
steps.headline: The switch-to-Grok clip, shorter and a little larger.
steps.changed: Replies play twice as fast and the clip moves on as soon as each reply lands, instead of waiting a fixed few seconds.
steps.notice: Same three messages and the model switch, with less dead air.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 2, "Hand it a spreadsheet, get something you can actually read."
steps.headline: The spreadsheet-to-chart clip, shorter and a little larger.
steps.changed: The same steps — chart, open it, edit the colour, save — with the doubled pauses between them removed and a slightly narrower file panel so the zoomed chat still fits.
steps.notice: The colour change still lands before the loop restarts.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 3, "Give it a task and it gets done, with boundaries you can trust."
steps.headline: The morning-inbox clip, shorter and a little larger.
steps.changed: All three approvals stay. Its reply is the longest, so it plays at two and a half times speed instead of two, and the pauses around each Yes are shorter.
steps.notice: Every approval is still on screen.
steps.risk: It has the most reading of any clip, and the reply text moves quickly.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 4, "Project view keeps your files, conversations, and assistant instructions organized."
steps.headline: The Project View clip, a little larger with the shared pauses.
steps.changed: Same three steps with shorter pauses between them.
steps.notice: Files and instructions are easier to read at the larger size.

steps.headline: The tags clip, shorter and a little larger, still opening the conversation in the preview.
steps.changed: Tag, search and preview are all kept; the pauses between them are shorter.
steps.notice: The preview stays open long enough to see what it shows.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 6, "Start on your laptop. Finish on your phone." (the computer half)
steps.headline: The computer half of the laptop-to-phone clip, shorter and a little larger.
steps.changed: The reply plays twice as fast and the long wait after it is gone.
steps.notice: The whole reply still shows before the loop restarts.
steps.risk: At about eight seconds it loops about twice as often as the others.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 6, "Start on your laptop. Finish on your phone." (the phone half)
steps.headline: The phone half, shortened the same way and still in step with the computer half.
steps.changed: Same script and pauses as the computer half; the phone is not zoomed, because a larger phone screen would rearrange itself.
steps.notice: Both halves still show the same moment together.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 7, "Describe a look. Install a plugin. Share both."
steps.headline: The theme-builder clip, shorter and a little larger.
steps.changed: The clip moves to the marketplace as soon as the reply finishes, instead of waiting six and a half seconds, and each marketplace step is quicker.
steps.notice: It still ends on the Golden Sunbreak window.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 8, "Four games, beside the conversation."
steps.headline: The games clip, shorter and a little larger.
steps.changed: The theme's drifting background is paused for this clip — it was slowing every click to about a second and a half. The opponent still thinks for a moment before each move.
steps.notice: Clicks land promptly and the win arrives sooner.
steps.risk: The background pattern is still there but does not drift in this clip.

steps.path: youcoded.ai — card 9, "Made to be customized and work with you."
steps.headline: The builders clip, a little larger with the shared pauses.
steps.changed: Same steps into Assistant settings with shorter pauses.
steps.notice: Settings text is easier to read at the larger size.
steps.risk: The second conversation it opens shows a yellow notice about a small context window; that is the sample conversation, and it was in the earlier clip too.
